title: RightsRecord
description: Rights and consent for one asset (PRD REQ-003), verbatim coverage: who owns or supplied it, permitted platforms, territories, campaign/expiry dates, talent and location release status, music status, and whether editing and paid amplification are permitted. REQ-003's closing rule is load-bearing: 'Unknown material is flagged rather than assumed cleared' — so `unknownRecord()` in this package produces `state: "unknown"` with every detail null, and there is no code path that defaults an absent record to `cleared`. Referenced by SourceAsset now and by the ContentPackage rights manifest from Phase 5.

state.description: Resolved posture. Derived by the ingest skill from the declared fields plus the ingest-time clock (an asset past `expiryDate` resolves to `expired` regardless of what the sidecar declared) — never copied blindly from the sidecar.

owner.description: Who owns the material. Null only when state is `unknown`.

supplier.description: Who supplied it, when different from the owner.

permittedPlatforms.description: Platforms this asset may be published to. An empty array means 'explicitly none' and is NOT the same as null ('not recorded').

territories.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 territory codes where use is permitted.

expiryDate.description: After this date the asset resolves to `expired`. Rights expiry is a NON-WAIVABLE packaging blocker (decisions.md D-35).

editingPermitted.description: Whether the supplier permits editing. Null (not recorded) is treated as 'no' by the packaging gate — Cutdown's entire output is edited material, so an unrecorded editing right cannot be assumed.

paidAmplificationPermitted.description: Whether paid amplification is permitted. Deliberately separate from `editingPermitted` and from `permittedPlatforms`: a grant to publish organically never implies a grant to run paid media against the same asset.

evidenceUri.description: Pointer to the underlying evidence (signed release, licence, contract). A claim of `cleared` with a null evidenceUri is recorded as-declared but is surfaced by the packaging gate as unevidenced.
